maddeler.e:
انطبقت (form VII)
# اِنْطَبَقْتُ (inṭabaqtu) /in.tˤa.baq.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْطَبَقَ (inṭabaqa)
# اِنْطَبَقْتَ (inṭabaqta) /in.tˤa.baq.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْطَبَقَ (inṭabaqa)
# اِنْطَبَقْتِ (inṭabaqti) /in.tˤa.baq.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْطَبَقَ (inṭabaqa)
# اِنْطَبَقَتْ (inṭabaqat) /in.tˤa.ba.qat/: third-pe
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
